description: Social platform connecting users around shared interests, content, or identity. Industry brain defines the community context. This core defines how social interaction works.

three_js.description: Connected node graph — dots linked by thin lines, nodes pulse when connections are active. Mimics a social network topology.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: Post has many Comments and Likes
Message belongs to a conversation between Users
Story belongs to User, expires after 24 hours
Collection belongs to User, contains Posts
Event is created by User or Group
Notification belongs to User, triggered by interactions
Report filed by User against Post, Comment, or User

layout.notes: Feed is the product. Every other screen is secondary. Create action must always be one tap away regardless of form factor.

avoid: Never paginate the feed — always infinite scroll
Never show follower count as the primary metric — show engagement rate or post count for new profiles
Never use a modal for creating a post — full-screen compose experience only
Never auto-play video with sound — always muted by default, tap to unmute
Never show ads between the first 3 posts — users haven't engaged yet
Never collapse comments — show first 2 always, expand to see all
Never use a generic avatar placeholder — always use initials on coloured background
Never show share count if zero — only show when > 0
enforce: Double-tap to like — heart animation plays on double-tap anywhere on post image
Like count updates optimistically — increment immediately on tap, sync in background
Story avatars always circular with gradient ring when unwatched
Unread notification badge on nav icon — disappears only when notification screen opened
Post timestamp always relative — '2h ago' not '14:32' — for posts under 24h
Profile always shows: avatar, username, bio, post count, follower count, following count
Report and block always accessible from post context menu — never hidden
New posts available indicator at top of feed — 'X new posts' — tap to refresh to top

empty_states.ui: Suggested accounts to follow — 5-6 cards with follow button. Message: 'Follow people to see their posts'. No empty feed shown.
Category chips at top. Below: 'Popular this week' grid populated from global trending — never truly empty.
Bell illustration. Message: 'No notifications yet'. Sub-message: 'When people like or comment on your posts, you'll see it here'.
Grid shows camera icon placeholder in centre. Message: 'Share your first post'. CTA: 'Create post'. Post count shows 0.

loading_states.ui: Skeleton post cards — avatar circle placeholder, name line, image block full width, action row (3 icon placeholders). Show 3 skeleton posts. Shimmer animation.
Grid skeleton — 3-col grid of square image placeholders. Shimmer.
Avatar skeleton circle top. Stats row 3 blocks. Grid of 9 square skeleton blocks below.

error_flows.ui: Post appears in feed with red error badge: 'Failed to post'. Retry option inline. Draft preserved. Never silently drop the post.
Failed image shows red border and retry icon in compose screen. Other images in multi-image post unaffected.
Profile shows reduced visibility notice to owner only. Posts remain visible to existing followers. Clear explanation of review process.
Comment not posted. Inline message to author: 'This comment may violate our guidelines'. Option to edit or dismiss.

edge_cases.ui: Truncate at 3 lines with 'more' link. Expanding shows full caption — never navigate to new screen just to read caption.
Blocked user's posts disappear from feed immediately. Their profile shows 'User not found'. Block is silent — blocked user not notified.
Show abbreviated count: '10.2K likes'. Never show full number for counts over 10,000 — wastes space.
Comments thread shows: 'This post has been deleted'. Comments remain visible. Thread not removed.
